name: Gruvbox Dark
license: MIT (package.json "license" field of morhetz/gruvbox; no LICENSE file in repo root; gruvbox-contrib has no LICENSE file either)

provenance.bg.base: spec: gruvbox.vim bg0 = dark0 (Normal bg, medium contrast)
provenance.bg.inset: choice: gruvbox's own 'hard' background, one step below bg0
provenance.fg.muted: spec: fg4 = StatusLineNC / secondary UI text
provenance.fg.on-accent: spec: Search/IncSearch draw bg0 on yellow/orange (inverse)
provenance.fg.title: spec: Title = green bold (ports use light1 2/3; swap if titles should stay neutral)
provenance.accent.primary: spec: PmenuSel = bg2 on blue, Underlined/links blue; consensus accent bright_blue 1/3
provenance.accent.secondary: choice: categorical contrast with blue; dark accent set bright_*
provenance.selection.bg: spec: Visual bg = bg3 (gruvbox default is inverse video)
provenance.status.error: spec: ErrorMsg red; dark accent set bright_*
provenance.status.warning: cross-scheme: warning = yellow 17/22 (gruvbox ports tie bright_orange/bright_yellow 1/3)
provenance.status.success: consensus: success bright_green 1/2; dark accent set
provenance.statusbar.bg: spec: StatusLine = fg1 on bg2; consensus dark2 2/3

notes: Terminal slots: morhetz/gruvbox-contrib xresources (2014, the author's only terminal definition); cursor/selection undefined (null).
Hard/soft contrast only change bg0 (dark0_hard #1d2021, dark0_soft #32302f); bg.inset uses dark0_hard.
